items.title: Solar Energy and Photovoltaic Cells (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Solar Energy and Photovoltaic Cells: a main subheading of 31.8 Nuclear Energy - Fission and Fusion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 228-231.

blocks.text: Solar PV (photovoltaic) system clean (saaf) energy ka system hai. Is ke solar panels aam taur par silicon semiconducting materials se bane hote hain aur photovoltaic effect se sunlight (dhoop) ki energy ko electricity mein badalte hain. Panel par dhoop parne se material ke electrons activate ho jate (harkat mein aa jate) hain aur direct current (DC) electricity banti hai. Phir inverter is DC ko alternating current (AC) mein badalta hai, jis se ghar, schools, offices aur industries chal sakte hain. System mein batteries bhi hoti hain jo raat ya cloudy (badal wale) dinon ke liye electricity store (jama) karti hain, voltage ko stable rakhne mein madad deti hain, aur zarurat par surge current (achanak zyada current) deti hain. Doosri cheezein, jaise electrical accessories, wires (taarein), appliances aur mounting structures (panels ke stand), poore solar system ko effective aur safe banati hain.

blocks.alt: Sunlight (sooraj se red teer) solar panel par parti hai. Wire panel se direct current inverter tak, aur inverter se alternating current lightbulb tak le jata hai. Panel ke neeche magnifier excited electrons wali oopar ki layer aur teen layers dikhata hai: (-) layer, diode aur (+) layer.

blocks.text: Dhoop silicon ki layers mein electrons ko excite karti hai; (-) aur (+) layers ke beech ka diode electrons ko aik hi direction (rukh) mein chalata hai, is liye panel direct current (DC) deta hai. Ghar ke appliances (aalaat) alternating current (AC) par chalte hain, is liye inverter DC ko AC mein badalta hai. Bohat se systems mein batteries bhi hoti hain jo raat aur badal ke liye electricity store karti hain; kitab ki figure mein battery nahi dikhayi gayi.

Solar energy ke traditional (purane) energy sources par kai bare faide hain. Yeh environment friendly aur renewable (khatam na hone wala) energy source hai, is liye climate change aur pollution (aaloodgi) ke khilaf larai mein madad deta hai. Solar panels lambe arse mein cost-effective (saste) bhi parte hain, kyunke install hone ke baad in ki maintenance (dekh bhaal) kam hai.

Energy shortages (energy ki kami), fuel ki oonchi prices (qeematein) aur climate (mausam) ke problems batate hain ke hamein solar, hydro (pani) aur wind (hawa) jaise renewable energy sources ki taraf jana chahiye.

blocks.prompt: a) Bohat se solar energy systems mein batteries kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Raat ya badal wale dinon ke liye electricity store (jama) karne ke liye, aur voltage stable rakhne aur surge current dene ke liye.

blocks.prompt: b) Bijli banane ke ilawa nuclear fission aur kahan use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Maslan kuch submarines aur ships (bahri jahazon) ko chalane mein, research reactors mein medicine (ilaj) aur research ke liye radioactive isotopes banane mein, aur nuclear weapons (hathiyaron) mein.

blocks.prompt: c) Reaction mein missing (ghaib) hissa pehchanein: ²³⁵U + n → ______ + ______ + 3n + energy
blocks.explanation: Barium-141 (¹⁴¹Ba) aur krypton-92 (⁹²Kr), jaisa upar wali equation mein hai. Mass numbers barabar hain: 235 + 1 = 141 + 92 + 3.

blocks.prompt: d) Nuclear reactions chemical reactions se kahin zyada energy kyun dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Nuclear reactions khud nucleus ko badalte hain, jahan bohat strong forces particles ko jore rakhti hain, aur thora sa mass bohat zyada energy ban jata hai. Chemical reactions mein sirf bahar ke electrons ki tarteeb (bonds) badalti hai.

items: Fission: heavy nucleus (U-235) toot'ta hai; neutrons chain reaction chalate hain.
Fission ke drawbacks: radioactive waste, accidents ka khatra (Chernobyl, Fukushima).
Solar PV: silicon panel DC deta hai; inverter AC banata hai; batteries electricity store karti hain.
